messages:
maya: quick async standup — noticed KV cache thrash on canary (canary-3) after the microkernel tweak. 95p latency for short seq jumped ~60ms. opened PR #4587 with an eviction-heuristics tweak (kv-evict-tune).

liam: saw that in the dashboards. i'll run prefetched-bench on s2 and p4-small in ~15m. want warmup=10 included?

samir: re: PR — left a small comment on the backoff math, looks like it might under-evict in steady state. can we add a TTL-per-key histogram to the perf dashboard too?

maya: good catch, samir — pushed a commit fixing the backoff and added a lightweight ttl histogram event (evict.ttl_hist) to Reporter.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy canary-3 -> staging succeeded at 1978886200. No rollout errors reported.

tess: starting prefetched-bench on p4-small now. config: `--seq-len 64 --batch 8 --warmup 5 --iters 200`. will paste numbers in a bit.

tess: results: median 14ms, 95p 78ms (before patch 95p was ~136ms). kv cache hit-rate ~92%. logs show `kv_evictions/sec=420` and occasional short spikes.

samir: those results look promising. can we run one with a slightly larger prefetch window + the evict-tune? my hypothesis: smoothing prefetch reduces transient miss storms.

maya: plan to roll canary with both evict-tune + prefetch +1 at 20:30 UTC and run a cross-tenant perf sweep overnight. blocking: need infra OK for the GPU window change — @nate can you greenlight?

nate: ok from infra, please tag canary and set `max-burst=2` for the rollout. i'll monitor logs and metrics during the sweep.

liam: quick CR ping — PR #4588 depends on #4587. if #4587 lands i can re-run the microbatch test and verify latency slope. @maya pls flag when merged.

maya: will wait for one more review then merge. i'll post merge + canary start time. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
